# Rounding numbers {-}

```{r tablesettings, echo = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
options(knitr.table.format = "html")
```

**Brief intro to rounding**

You can use the base R `round()` function to round numbers.

```
?round
```

For instance, it is a good rule of thumb to report the standard deviation to one more digit than the mean:

```{r}
mydata <- c(4.4, 8.5, 10.1, 14.0, 3.9)
mean.mydata <- mean(mydata)
sd.mydata <- sd(mydata)
```

Now round the numbers:

```{r}
round(mean.mydata, digits = 2)
round(sd.mydata, digits = 3)
```
